notes: Calibrated against the labelled corpus, not provisional. v3 rebuilt v2's component set rather than re-tuning it. Four measured defects drove it: (1) the bootstrap sd of a v2 score was 0.027 against a human band 0.133 wide, so v2's ordering inside that band was noise; (2) 0.06 of weight sat on search_advantage, which has zero variance across all ten human variants of the time, and several more components were pinned at 1.00 for over 80 percent of the corpus; (3) skill_gradient and rating_spread correlate +0.93, so 0.22 of weight expressed one measurement twice; (4) rule_mass as lower_better correlates +0.88 with branching and +0.82 with rating spread, meaning the elegance term subtracted from the depth signal and both broken controls took the top of the family. v3 replaces level measurements with skill-response measurements wherever it can, replaces rule_mass with rule_yield, and moves the components that could not express a difference to gates. Measured on the 18 scoreable committed rulesets plus the mutant corpus: human band 0.716-0.859, chess 0.814 sixth of eighteen, separation -0.055 against a best known-bad mutant of 0.771, sign accuracy 90 percent, null stability 0.000. Separation is negative for one diagnosed pair and was deliberately not tuned away; see docs/plan.md stage 10. Curve ends were placed by metrics/calibration.py anchor_curves from the labelled corpus, with spans floored at three times the component's resampling sd and twice the human band width. Components asked for here that the analysis pass supplies -- decision_criticality, piece_utilisation, blunder_recoverability -- mean a corpus must be analysed before it can be scored under this version.

gates.reason: a searching player must beat a random one, or there is nothing to play
a game that mostly fails to finish is not a game
with no choices there is no play
a game that competent players almost always draw is not a contest
a game decided before either player has developed anything is not a game
doubling the thinking budget must be worth at least a few Elo, or skill does not exist here

a game where half of all contests are over in a handful of moves is decided by an opening trap, not by play; it correlates -0.89 with distinct_game_rate, so scoring it as well as gating it counted one measurement twice
